verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence says whether Fellow uses meeting data to train AI models, describes an org-level training opt-out, or states a SOC 2 or HIPAA posture. Retention policies, zero-day retention, Super Admin data deletion and a generic "enterprise-grade security" line are related controls, not the requested training disclosure, opt-out or compliance attestations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
